# Configuration

The service is configured only through environment variables, validated at startup by the schema in `src/config/env.ts`. Validation is fail-fast: if any variable is invalid the process exits with status 1 and lists every problem at once.

Repository field mappings and public-access filters are not runtime configuration. They are code, in `config/repositories/`; see [Repositories](./repositories.md).

## Service

| Variable | Default | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PORT` | `3000` | port (1–65535) | HTTP listen port. |
| `ENVIRONMENT` | required | `stage`, `production` | Deployment environment, printed in the startup log line. |
| `BUILD_VERSION` | required | string | Release identifier. Returned by `GET /version` and the health endpoints, and sent as the MCP server version. |
| `BUILD_COMMIT` | required | string | Source commit of the build. Returned by `GET /version` and the health endpoints. |

## JScholarship

| Variable | Default | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `JSCHOLARSHIP_SOLR_URL` | required | http(s) URL | Full URL of the private DSpace Solr collection used for candidate retrieval. |
| `JSCHOLARSHIP_API_URL` | required | http(s) URL | Base URL of the DSpace REST API, the canonical source for every returned record. |
| `JSCHOLARSHIP_PUBLIC_URL` | required | http(s) URL | Public site base URL used to build landing-page links. |

## JHRDR

| Variable | Default | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `JHRDR_SOLR_URL` | empty | URL (not validated) | Full URL of the private Dataverse Solr collection. The JHRDR adapter is only created when this and `JHRDR_API_URL` are both set; otherwise the server runs JScholarship alone. |
| `JHRDR_API_URL` | empty | URL (not validated) | Base URL of the Dataverse Native API, the canonical source for JHRDR records. |
| `JHRDR_PUBLIC_URL` | `https://archive.data.jhu.edu` | URL (not validated) | Public site base URL used to build JHRDR landing-page links. |

## Edge security

| Variable | Default | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ALLOWED_HOSTS` | required | comma-separated list | Accepted `Host` header values for `/mcp` (DNS-rebinding defense). Must contain at least one entry. |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | empty | comma-separated list | Accepted browser `Origin` values. Empty rejects every request that carries an `Origin`; clients that send no `Origin` are unaffected. |
| `MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `65536` | non-negative number | Largest accepted request body; larger requests get HTTP 413. |

## Timeouts

| Variable | Default | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TIMEOUT_SOLR_MS` | `5000` | milliseconds | Per-request timeout for backend calls. Currently applied to both Solr and the canonical API clients. |
| `TIMEOUT_API_MS` | `5000` | milliseconds | Parsed into `timeouts.canonicalApiMs` but not currently read; canonical API calls use `TIMEOUT_SOLR_MS`. |
| `TIMEOUT_DEADLINE_MS` | `10000` | milliseconds | Overall deadline for one `/mcp` request. Values above 30000 are clamped to 30000. |

## Concurrency

| Variable | Default | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `MAX_TOOL_CONCURRENCY` | `10` | count | Tool calls allowed in flight per task. Calls beyond the limit fail fast with `rate_limited`. |
| `MAX_CANONICALIZATION_WORKERS` | `5` | count | Concurrent canonical API look-ups per adapter while validating candidates. |

## Cache

| Variable | Default | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CACHE_SEARCH_TTL_MS` | `60000` | milliseconds | Lifetime of cached, already-validated repository search pages. |
| `CACHE_RECORD_TTL_MS` | `60000` | milliseconds | Lifetime of cached single records. Cached records are re-probed before they are served. |
| `CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES` | `500` | count | Maximum entries in each bounded LRU cache. |
